body:
Replaced Abraham's W (a free toggle that only boosted Q's damage) with A Line of Fire: a real ground-targeted, slow, long-range, piercing skill-shot. New generic ground-target cast protocol (ArenaCastCmd.has_ground_target/target_x/target_z), a real piercing ArenaProjectile (pierce/pierced_mask, damages every enemy in its path in one pass), a 400ms GOLDENBAND-driven ease-in/out rotation + golden-ratio squish/flick windup animation (client-visual only), and a homing/ranged basic auto-attack matching Gary's mechanic with its own color. abraham_fireball_mod.prn is REDGARDEN's 6th real PARENA mod. Q's damage buffed to the old 'channeling' value since W's toggle is gone. 7 new tests, all real assertions in scripts/test_arena.sh pass, scripts/test_10_bots.sh verified live (5 matches, 10 bots). Commit 961d500.

⚓ ☃
title: Abraham W rework: A Line of Fire, ground-targeted piercing fireball (S202-34)
